question: _________ was appointed as the first Surveyor General of India in the year 1815.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Colin Mackenzie.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ****Surveyor General of India is the Head of the Department of Survey of India,** a Department under the Ministry of Science and Technology of the Government of India.
 
• Colin Mackenzie was appointed as **the first Surveyor General of India in 1815.**
 
• He holds this post from **1815 to 1821.**
 
• It was he who produced the **first authentic geographical map of south India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major James Rennell **received training in surveying in the Royal Navy.
 
• He joined the East India Company in 1763 and was **the first Surveyor General of Bengal.**
 
• He carried out the **first comprehensive geographical survey of India.**
 
• **Colonel George Everest** was a British surveyor and geographer who served as Surveyor General of India from **1830 to 1843.**
